content.short: Orcfax is a decentralized oracle service on Cardano providing verifiably accurate real-world data feeds.
content.description: Orcfax is a premier decentralized oracle protocol built on the Cardano blockchain, dedicated to providing high-fidelity, real-world data to smart contracts. By collecting, normalizing, and auditing data from multiple sources, the platform ensures that on-chain applications have access to verifiably accurate information for DeFi, gaming, and governance. Node operators stake the native $FACT token to participate in the network, ensuring data integrity through economic incentives. Orcfax is a vital infrastructure component that enables complex and reliable decentralized applications.
